system.description:
You can craft illusions of inky shadow, particularly convincing in dark settings. You can create a human-sized illusion with little effort; to evoke something larger, expend one or more Social Traits (up to two for Intermediate, three for Advanced, four for Elder), each Trait doubling the illusion's size. These illusions affect only sight, though subtle inclusion of Arms of Ahriman can add to the effect. In darkness, witnesses may attempt a Mental Challenge to determine the illusion is not real; in bright light the effect is usually convincing only at a distance. Used subtly, this ability grants three extra Traits in situations involving dodging, intimidation or stealth.

You can also create an area of whirling shadowy nightmare; those affected gain the Negative Trait Clumsy and are three Traits down in any challenges, with Auspex of no assistance. Weak mortals may be overcome — if a mortal has seven or fewer current Physical Traits, he begins to suffocate, losing one Physical Trait per turn, then one health level per turn until smothered. Nightshades last for one scene or until dispelled.
